why: Items 1, 2 and 4 are met. Builder step 6 runs `npm install` and commits package-lock.json so `npm ci` works. Step 5 says to "replace the 'No tools yet: packages/ is empty' bullet". Check 6 reads the PR body and runs `gh pr checks` at the head. Item 3 fails. Check 4 runs `npm test --workspace packages/jsonl-lint`, which is not the root npm test. Check 6 runs the root `npm ci && npm test` but only checks that it passes. Because the root script uses --if-present, that can pass with the workspace tests skipped. No check reads the test count or breaks lint() to show a test failing, so the verifier would not notice the tests being skipped.
